# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

The instructions for working in this repository are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at its
top. Read that file first and follow it: it has the commands, the layout and the rules.

This file exists because some Copilot surfaces (the JetBrains and Visual Studio chats) read
only `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and not `AGENTS.md`. Keep the content in AGENTS.md
and leave this as a pointer, so that there is one set of instructions for every agent.
